_note: Single source of tunable values for scan3d. Every script reads this file; any run can override a value with --set section.key=value.

capture._note: Scan profile sent to POST /scan/start (Pi). Hardware limits in stream.py still apply (quality <= 85, fps <= 20 above 1640x1232).

receiver._note: PC side of the live push (scan3d/receiver.py).

capture_cli._note: python -m scan3d.capture: seconds recorded after the second Enter, progress print interval.

aruco._note: Taken from the Trova repo: trova/calibration.py (ARUCO_DICT, ids 0-3, load_marker_positions) and docs/make_guide.py ('4 printed ArUco markers, 5 cm wide'). marker_mm is the side of the black square, white border excluded.

placement._note: Repo default when data/markers.json is missing: ids 0-3 at the corners of a TROVA_TABLE_W_MM x TROVA_TABLE_H_MM area (600 x 400 mm), clockwise from top-left as seen by the camera. With the camera on the arm, the real centres are recorded by touching each one with the arm tip (UI: Record marker from arm) into data/markers.json.

scan_placement._note: Scan-scale markers (scan3d only; Trova calibration ignores them because it only uses the ids in data/markers.json). Flat on the table around the object, about 5-10 cm from it, e.g. the corners of a 25 x 25 cm square centred on the object. Exact positions do not matter; only their size does. They must not move during a scan.

aruco_scan._note: Markers that set the mm scale of a scan. In use since 2026-11-04: two found cubes with ARUCO_MIP_36h12 markers (ids 4 on the left cube, 2 on top and 3 on the side of the right cube), detected from the Pi camera. marker_mm = side of the BLACK square, measured by Giacomo with a ruler: 39 mm. ids empty = any id of the dictionary.

aruco_print3d._note: 3D-printed markers (two colours), printed FACE DOWN: the pattern is in the first layers on the plate, white backing above. scan3d/make_markers_3d.py.

reconstruct._note: scan3d/reconstruct.py. 'common' applies to both modes; 'preview' / 'full' override it. max_images 0 = all. scale_source 'arm': scale and robot frame from the arm's rest poses when the scan has arm.json (scan3d/armpose.py), else the markers; 'markers': markers only. arm_rest_margin_s: dropped at the start of each rest window; arm_rest_per_view: rest frames kept per view (always in the image selection); the arm fit needs arm_min_frames from arm_min_views and a median camera-centre residual <= arm_max_residual_mm.

mesh._note: Open3D post-processing in mm (table plane z = 0). pick: 'center' = largest cluster near the orbit centre, 'largest' = largest cluster. L and W are measured on points above size_skip_bottom_frac of the height (the table/object junction smears outwards), between the size_percentile and 100-size_percentile percentiles.

orbit._note: python -m scan3d.orbit (xArm 5 camera orbit). mm and degrees, robot base frame. camera_offset_mm / camera_axis_flange: first guess of the camera's optical centre and axis in the FLANGE frame (z = out of the flange); the fit replaces the axis (and the offset with --fit-offset). Object size is used for the look-at height (with a T pose) and for collision checks. distance_mm 0 / elevations_deg [] = take them from the taught poses. joint_limits_deg narrows the xArm 5 limits for planning (J2 >= -60: the arm never leans back behind its base). base_*: the arm's own column, kept clear of the wrist and camera. use_cad_geometry (default true): real shapes from arm_pc/robot_model.json (UFactory xArm 5 meshes + the camera head CAD, Camera Gatto.step) for collisions, including the head against the arm (self_margin_mm), with the cad_*_margin_mm margins; the optical centre also comes from the CAD (camera_offset_mm and the capsule sizes are used only when it is false).

quality._note: Step 0 dependency smoke only. Full metric masks, quality reconstruction and coverage are not implemented.
